label: theory:cr-secondary-ratio 1D thin disc with convection and decay (SymPy 1.14.0)
assumptions: steady state; parents are pure primaries with given mid-plane ratios; secondaries fed by parents only, plus the decay gain of a radioactive secondary's daughter (10Be -> 10B)
kinetic energy per nucleon conserved in fragmentation and in decay (straight-ahead); same v for all species
constant convective speed V_c sign(z) in the whole halo, conservative form d/dz(V N); adiabatic energy change, reacceleration and all other energy changes neglected
decay rate 1/(gamma tau_0) in the whole halo; decay inside the thin disc neglected (measure zero)
fully stripped 7Be cannot decay by electron capture and is treated as stable
thin disc: gas and sources in 2 h delta(z); free escape at |z| = L; cross sections are inputs (effective, cumulative), hydrogen target only

conventions.unit_system: symbols in any consistent unit system; the code uses CGS (cm, s, g)
conventions.frame: Galactic rest frame; observer at the disc mid-plane z = 0
conventions.convection: V_c(z) = V_c sign(z), conservative form d/dz(V_c(z) N)
